raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

When an embedding request reuses a cached prefix, the scheduler recomputes only the suffix of the sequence (the match is capped one short of the input, so at most the last token is guaranteed). The pooler then indexes the produced hidden states as if they covered the full sequence. With CLS or MEAN pooling, pooled classification scores, or request-level pooling positions, the rows the pooler reads were never recomputed, so the request silently returns the hidden state of the wrong tokens.

Reproduced on current main with BGE-small on CPU (no GPU needed), two identical `[10, 11, 12]` requests to `/encode`:

- first request (cold cache): `[-0.0645, -0.0517, 0.0350, ...]` — the correct CLS embedding
- second request (prefix hit, recomputes only token 12): `[-0.0542, -0.0084, 0.0228, ...]` — token 12's hidden state, wrong

Every identical request after the first returns the wrong value until the entry is evicted. LAST pooling is unaffected because the last token is always recomputed.

## Modifications

- `EmbeddingModelSpec.pooling_may_read_prefix`: true for CLS/MEAN pooling, bidirectional attention (whose cached KV is itself only valid for the original full sequence), and classification execution.
- `Req` carries the flag from `model_config.embedding_model_spec`, and `_compute_max_prefix_len` returns 0 for it — and for requests with `token_indices_to_pool` or `multi_item_delimiter_indices` — forcing a full recompute instead of a prefix match.
- LAST-pooling models (llama/qwen-style decoder embeddings) keep reusing prefixes; pinned by tests.
- New CPU unit test `test_embedding_prefix_pooling.py` for the spec property and the Req guard.

## Accuracy and Benchmark

- Same CPU BGE-small server after the fix: identical requests now return identical embeddings on cold and warm cache (all equal to the cold-cache value above).
- `pytest test/registered/unit/managers/test_embedding_prefix_pooling.py` — 8 passed; existing `test_embedding_model_spec.py` — 7 passed.

Deliberately out of scope: these models still write KV that nobody reads back (harmless; skipping the write can be a follow-up), and the unrelated #4753 warmup workaround is untouched (its "embedding errors for list of size 1" premise no longer reproduces — batch-of-1 works today).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Code Formatting with Pre-Commit](https://docs.sglang.ai/references/contribution_guide.html#code-formatting-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests as outlined in the [Running Unit Tests](https://docs.sglang.ai/references/contribution_guide.html#running-unit-tests-adding-to-ci).
- [ ] Update documentation / docstrings / example tutorials as needed — not needed; no user-facing configuration change.
- [ ] Provide throughput / latency benchmark results and accuracy evaluation results as needed — not applicable for a correctness fix; LAST-pooling behavior is unchanged by construction and pinned by the new tests.

+    @property
+    def pooling_may_read_prefix(self) -> bool:
+        """Whether pooling can read hidden states at positions a radix-cache
+        hit would not recompute.
+
+        A prefix hit recomputes only the suffix (at most the last token is
+        guaranteed, since the match is capped one short of the input), so
+        only last-token pooling stays correct.  CLS and MEAN read rows inside
+        the cached prefix; classification scores read pooled non-last rows;
+        and bidirectional attention makes even the cached KV itself depend on
+        the full original sequence, so no suffix of a different request may
+        reuse it.
+        """
+        if self.attention == AttentionPattern.BIDIRECTIONAL:
+            return True
+        if self.pooling in (PoolingStrategy.CLS, PoolingStrategy.MEAN):
+            return True
+        return self.execution == EmbeddingExecution.CLASSIFICATION

@@ -0,0 +1,80 @@
+"""Prefix-cache reuse vs. embedding pooling.
+
+A radix prefix hit recomputes only the suffix of a request (at most the last
+token, since the match is capped one short of the input).  Pooling that reads
+hidden states at positions inside the cached prefix -- CLS, MEAN, pooled
+classification scores, or request-level custom pooling positions -- would
+silently read rows that were never recomputed, returning the embedding of the
+wrong tokens.  These tests pin the contract: such requests must recompute the
+full sequence, while last-token pooling keeps reusing prefixes.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+from array import array
+
+from sglang.srt.configs.embedding_model_spec import resolve_embedding_model_spec
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import Req
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=4, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _spec(architectures, *, is_embedding_requested=False, is_embedding_gemma=False):
+    return resolve_embedding_model_spec(
+        architectures,
+        is_embedding_requested=is_embedding_requested,
+        is_embedding_gemma=is_embedding_gemma,
+    )
+
+
+class TestPoolingMayReadPrefix(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_cls_encoder_reads_prefix(self):
+        self.assertTrue(_spec(["BertModel"]).pooling_may_read_prefix)
+        self.assertTrue(_spec(["XLMRobertaModel"]).pooling_may_read_prefix)
+
+    def test_mean_embedding_gemma_reads_prefix(self):
+        self.assertTrue(
+            _spec(["Gemma3TextModel"], is_embedding_gemma=True).pooling_may_read_prefix
+        )
+        self.assertTrue(_spec(["EmbeddingGemma2Model"]).pooling_may_read_prefix)
+
+    def test_classification_reads_prefix(self):
+        self.assertTrue(
+            _spec(["BertForSequenceClassification"]).pooling_may_read_prefix
+        )
+
+    def test_last_token_decoder_pooling_keeps_reuse(self):
+        self.assertFalse(_spec(["LlamaEmbeddingModel"]).pooling_may_read_prefix)
+        self.assertFalse(
+            _spec(
+                ["Qwen3ForCausalLM"], is_embedding_requested=True
+            ).pooling_may_read_prefix
+        )
+
+    def test_generation_model_keeps_reuse(self):
+        self.assertFalse(_spec(["Qwen3ForCausalLM"]).pooling_may_read_prefix)
+
+
+class TestComputeMaxPrefixLen(unittest.TestCase):
+    def _req(self, **kwargs):
+        return Req("r0", None, array("q", [10, 11, 12, 13]), None, **kwargs)
+
+    def test_plain_request_matches_up_to_last_minus_one(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self._req()._compute_max_prefix_len(4), 3)
+
+    def test_prefix_reading_pooling_forces_full_recompute(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            self._req(pooling_may_read_prefix=True)._compute_max_prefix_len(4), 0
+        )
+
+    def test_custom_pooling_positions_force_full_recompute(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            self._req(token_indices_to_pool=[0])._compute_max_prefix_len(4), 0
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            self._req(multi_item_delimiter_indices=[1])._compute_max_prefix_len(4), 0
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
